Apollo Billing: Hi Redwood — sending invoice INV-2026-044. PO #PO-8845 on file but tax was split into two lines (state/local) which our AP system didn't match to your PO. Can someone confirm PO routing?
Maria K: @Apollo Billing can you attach the invoice PDF? we don't see the tax lines in our PO. quick screenshot helps.
Apollo Billing: Attached. lines:
```
1 x Server Racks - $12,000
1 x Shipping - $150
Sales Tax (State) - $900
Sales Tax (Local) - $90
Total: $13,140
PO: PO-8845 (line item matches Server Racks)
```
Maria K: Hmm looks like PO only references product amount, not tax. AP usually matches if tax is on same invoice but our PO system expects tax on single line. tagging @Jonah L for routing.
Jonah L: @Maria K @Apollo Billing thanks. AP system rules: it tries to match line-level amounts. If tax is split into multiple tax lines it sometimes fails. We can do two things: vendor reissue with single tax line or finance create manual match. Which does vendor prefer?
Apollo Billing: Reissuing will take 2 business days. Manual match would be faster.
Arjun P: I can do manual match but need approver chain for invoices >$10k. Who's the approver for PO-8845?
Maria K: Approver should be @Neil R (Eng-Platform) per PO metadata. Neil's out today but can we route to his backup @Anita S?
Jonah L: Anita S will approve as backup. @InvoiceBot can you create a manual match ticket and route to Anita?
InvoiceBot: Ticket FIN-9421 created: manual match request for INV-2026-044 (PO-8845). Routing to Anita S. ETA 1 business day. :white_check_mark:
Anita S: I can approve. Please add a note confirming vendor invoice number and attach PO screenshot.
Maria K: Done — attached PO screenshot and vendor PDF. Anita, ping me if you need GL allocation changes.
Anita S: Reviewing now. If all good I'll approve and mark matched.
Apollo Billing: Thanks all. we'll hold reissue unless you need it.
Arjun P: Manual match in progress, tagging finance for audit trail. once approved i'll post the matching journal entry.
Maria K: thx team :thumbsup:
InvoiceBot: FIN-9421 status updated: Approved by Anita S at 1928007730.
